decision: Falsify or establish full-checkpoint compatibility of the existing GLM-specific four-part AWQ loader patch on the cheapest viable Nebius GPU before spending on performance or quality measurement.

causal_hypothesis.primary: The audited SGLang patch correctly composes fused Q/KV-A compressed metadata, recognizes packed compressed projections, and canonically dequantizes compressed KV-B during MLA post-load, allowing the exact public GLM-4.7-Flash INT4 checkpoint to load and produce deterministic greedy output on one L40S.
causal_hypothesis.stock_control: The valid complete BF16 v13 H100 control loaded 48 shards, passed the fixed service SLO at 305.045 output tok/s c8, and failed the absolute quality screen; v14 is compatibility-only and cannot be compared economically until it passes.
causal_hypothesis.expected_direction: Full load and two exact-identical greedy responses pass; model VRAM is materially below complete BF16, establishing eligibility for a matched L40S performance/paired-quality run.
causal_hypothesis.falsification_value: A deterministic loader exception, OOM, metadata rejection, non-deterministic output, or preemptible service failure rejects this exact patch/device path or records an infrastructure interruption without silently promoting it.

changed_lineage.prior_gpu_evidence: RunPod attempt 2 reached all four shards and exposed the dense-only compressed KV-B defect; attempt 3 timed out after one cold shard before reaching the four-part patch; attempt 4 was interrupted without a valid artifact.
changed_lineage.candidate_change: Exact checkpoint is locally hash-verified and streamed to Nebius; runtime receives the completed four-part patch; provider, GPU, host memory, artifact delivery, and timeout all change.
changed_lineage.repeat_classification: First GPU execution that can reach the completed four-part patch; not an unchanged failed placement.

model.delivery_gate: all local file hashes before provider mutation; tiny write/hash probe; tar over SSH; all hashes rechecked inside the container before load

intervention.runtime_patch: GLM fused packed-module mapping and quant init; 2-vector fused weight_shape composition; compressed packed-projection detection; canonical INT4 KV-B dequantization before MLA decomposition
intervention.reason_for_disabled_optimizations: isolate loader correctness and deterministic execution before performance tuning

workload_geometry.request: two sequential identical temperature-0 chat completions asking for a small JSON object

quality_gate.required: both HTTP requests succeed and normalized content/reasoning/tool-call structures are exactly identical
quality_gate.absolute_quality: not evaluated; complete BF16 absolute failure is carried forward
quality_gate.paired_quality: not evaluated until a matched workload performance run is admitted
quality_gate.claim_limit: pass establishes compatibility and determinism only, never quality parity or cost improvement

service_contract.queueing: sequential concurrency one; server request-time stats retained
service_contract.preemption: a provider stop before evidence completion is an infrastructure failure, not model evidence

predictions.full_load: pass, but uncertainty is high because the completed KV-B branch has never run on GPU
predictions.business: no cost claim; a pass admits an L40S fixed-workload and paired-quality experiment whose preemptible $0.88/M threshold is approximately 271 output tok/s including disk

budget.limitations: public IPv4 and egress excluded; provider invoice pending

artifact_contract.cleanup: retrieve and hash evidence before deletion; verify instance GET not-found and zero experiment-named instances/disks

falsification_rules.delivery: Any local or remote hash/count/byte mismatch stops before load.
falsification_rules.compatibility: Any deterministic patch, metadata, load, OOM, or generation failure rejects this exact patch/device configuration.
falsification_rules.service: Any missing response or non-identical greedy response fails the smoke.
falsification_rules.preemption: Record as infrastructure failure and do not treat as loader evidence; do not repeat unchanged on preemptible if it preempts.
falsification_rules.repeat: Do not repeat an identical model/runtime/device failure.
falsification_rules.business: No speed, quality parity, dollar-per-token, or provider comparison is admitted from this smoke.
